> "When lazslo calls a referendum, xe may choose a younger vampire".

Quotes aren't for paraphrasing:

"When Laszlo calls a referendum, he may choose a younger vampire."

> Do i have to announce announce a methuselah that xis/xer vampire
> cannot vote the moment i play, say, a Banishment, or when the blocks
> are declined by my fellow methuselah can i say "ok the terms of the
> referendums are this and that, and oh by the way i choose a younger
> vampire and xe cannot vote during this referendum".

The latter. When he calls a referendum, not when he attempts a
political action.

> Yes, the problem is the word "call". Thank xou for xour answer !

The answer also lies therein.
